# Federal Grant Program Accessibility Evaluation Plan

> **For Claude:** Use a11y-planner protocol. Review with a11y-critic after implementation.
> **Compliance target:** Revised Section 508 (WCAG 2.0 Level A/AA + statutory provisions)
> **Users who need accessibility:** Applicants using screen readers, screen magnification, keyboard-only navigation, high-contrast mode; staff using assistive tech; low-vision and cognitive accessibility users.
> **Assistive technologies:** NVDA (Windows), JAWS (Windows), VoiceOver (macOS/iOS), Windows Magnifier, High Contrast Mode, keyboard-only input.

**Feature:** Comprehensive accessibility evaluation of the Office of Rural Grants Administration's digital services prior to IT contract renewal.
**Risk Level:** High (federal procurement requirement, active litigation/complaint risk, multi-platform scope with complex forms and media)
**Component/Page Type:** Multi-product audit scope: Public website (~120 pages), Grant application portal (~25 screens/forms), Training video library (~40 videos), Guidance PDFs (~200 files), Staff intranet (policy/HR).

---

## Scope & Context (EM Step 1 Artifacts)

**Product Scope:**
- **In-Scope:** Public Drupal website, React grant application portal (all authenticated and unauthenticated states), Training video library (custom player + media assets), Guidance PDFs linked from the public site.
- **Out-of-Scope:** Staff intranet *unless* the contracting officer confirms legal applicability under Revised Section 508. If included, it will be sampled identically to the public site but evaluated against the same floor. Native app screens or hardware kiosks (if any) are outside this web measurement stack and assigned to manual/AT methods in the coverage boundary.
- **Conformance Target:** Revised Section 508 floor: WCAG 2.0 Level A/AA as incorporated by the Rehabilitation Act, plus applicable non-WCAG 508 provisions (E205.2/E205.3 scope, E205.4 exception, 503.4/503.4.1/503.4.2 caption/audio-description controls).
- **Accessibility Support Baseline:** Windows 10/11 + Chrome/Firefox; macOS/iOS Safari; NVDA (free), JAWS, VoiceOver; Screen Magnifier; High Contrast Mode. Agreed with commissioner: these combinations drive the evaluation matrix.
- **Additional Requirements:** VPAT 2.4 report template; issue-report granularity per agency standard; user involvement (screen reader/magnification testers for portal flows); 12-week timeline to written report.

**Risk Factors:**
- Active complaint from a screen reader applicant indicates potential critical failures in form navigation, error association, or timeout handling.
- Multi-step application with 20-minute inactivity timeout triggers WCAG 2.1/2.2 timing controls and Section 508 functional performance criteria (FPC).
- Custom video player with nested controls requires manual verification of keyboard operability and ARIA state correctness.
- ~200 PDFs include scanned documents, which fall outside the web measurement stack and require dedicated manual evaluation.

---

## Sampling & Evaluation Strategy (EM Step 2/3)

**Structured Sample Set:**
- **Public Website:** Search results page, eligibility/rules page, county office locator (interactive map/list), news archive, contact form.
- **Grant Portal:** Login redirect, account creation/shared login fallback, step 1 application form, file upload screen, timeout warning screen, status check dashboard, reviewer message inbox.
- **Video Library:** Player with captions enabled, player without captions, AD toggle submenu, play/volume toolbar controls.
- **PDFs:** 3 native-text PDFs (application worksheet), 3 scanned PDFs (annual report), 1 policy guidance with tables/images.

**Random Sample Set:** 10% of the structured set, drawn from views not already selected. Selection method: pseudo-random URL extraction via sitemap + CMS export.

**Complete Processes:**
- Application submission flow (default path + error branch on invalid fields)
- Timeout recovery sequence (20-min warning → extend → resume or discard)
- Video playback sequence (play → toggle CC → toggle AD → pause/stop)
- County locator search → result list → filter application

**State Coverage per Sample:** Default, loading, error, expanded/dialog states are evaluated as part of each sample.

---

## Tooling & Government Test Coverage (ICT Baseline Crosswalk)

Procurement requires an explicit list of which government-required tests the process performs and which it does not. The evaluation uses a multi-layer stack: axe-core (runtime scanning), Playwright spec tests (zoom/reflow/focus), kat (keyboard-a11y-tester driven journeys), vsr (virtual screen reader component assertions), agent-browser (ARIA snapshot/recon), and manual/AT sessions.

**Coverage Statement:** *designed to cover 22 of 62 fully; partial coverage for 26; gaps (not-covered): 13.*

| Coverage Level | Tests Covered | Method / Tool |
|----------------|---------------|---------------|
| **Covered** | Keyboard Access, No Keyboard Trap, Focus Visible/Order/OnFocus, Control Name/Role/State/Value, Contrast Minimum, Page Titles, Data Table Roles, Layout Tables, Language of Page, Frames/iFrames, Resize Text (200% zoom/reflow), Bypass Blocks | axe-core rules, playwright-spec `.spec.js`, kat trace/findings, vsr computed names/roles, agent-browser ARIA snapshots |
| **Partial** | Non-Interference, Consistent Navigation/Identification, Meaningful/Decorative Images, Use of Color, Form Labels Descriptive, Error Identification/Suggestion/Prevention, Heading Descriptiveness, Link Purpose in Context, Language of Parts, Media Player Controls/Caption Level, Timing Adjustable, Moving Info, Auto-updating, Audio Control, Multiple Ways, Related Web Pages | axe-core + manual AT verification; human judgment required for equivalence, descriptiveness, and process determination |
| **Not-Covered** (Manual/AT) | Captchas, Images of Text, Sensory Characteristics, Audible Cues, Flashing Content, Audio/Video-only Alternatives, AD Prerecorded, Live Captions, Sync Media Alternative, Conforming Alternate Version, Parsing (always-passes per upstream), Document Equivalence | Manual listening/watching sessions; human equivalence judgment; Electronic Documents baseline methods |
| **Always Passes** | Parsing (24.A) | Upstream Test Instructions: "No testing necessary"; result is automatic pass. Real markup consequences reported under other SCs' tests. |

**PDF & Intranet Boundary:** PDFs and Office documents are outside the web measurement stack. They map to the Electronic Documents baseline (57 declared tests), not this crosswalk. They require manual/AT methods in the evaluation plan's coverage boundary and cannot ride along in the automated pass. The intranet follows the same boundary rule; inclusion requires a scope gate decision from the contracting officer before sampling begins.

---

## Addressing Specific Requirements

### 1. Web Lead's HTML Checker Expectation
HTML validators (e.g., W3C Nu Validator) check markup syntax compliance, not accessibility conformance. WCAG 2.0/508 requires semantic structure, ARIA correctness, keyboard operability, screen reader compatibility, and state communication—none of which an HTML checker validates. The final report will **not** list HTML validator warnings as Section 508 violations. Instead, we will use axe-core for runtime ARIA/contrast/landmark validation and manual AT sessions for semantic/keyboard verification. Markup errors that break accessibility (e.g., invalid nesting causing name/role/state failures) will be reported under the relevant SC test, not as generic HTML errors.

### 2. WCAG 2.2 Assumption vs. Revised Section 508 Floor
Revised Section 508 legally mandates **WCAG 2.0 Level A/AA** as its conformance floor. WCAG 2.1/2.2 criteria (e.g., 4.1.3 Status Messages, 1.4.10 Reflow, 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured, 2.5.8 Target Size) are **recommendations for remediation**, not conformance targets for a declared-508 evaluation. The report will use a dual posture:
- **REPORT conformance** against the floor (WCAG 2.0 A/AA + named 508 provisions). WCAG 2.1/2.2-only criteria will never be labeled as Section 508 failures.
- **RECOMMEND remediation** against WCAG 2.2 AA. The delta will be explicitly declared in both directions: (a) target-not-floor (2.1/2.2 SCs are recommendations), (b) floor-not-target (4.1.1 Parsing is formally in the 508 basis but removed from WCAG 2.2; it auto-passes by upstream design).

### 3. Screen Magnification on Small Laptops
WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow is a WCAG 2.1/2.2 criterion, not the 508 floor. However, Windows Magnifier behavior and general low-vision usability fall under Section 508's Functional Performance Criteria (FPC) and general accessibility expectations for federal digital services. We will test at 200% zoom per standard practice. Findings that fail reflow or focus obstruction will be reported as WCAG 2.1/2.2 recommendations, with FPC applicability noted where the 508 floor requires equivalent functionality.

### 4. Official Government Approval or Stamp
No automated tool, evaluation methodology, or testing service carries "official government approval" or a conformance stamp. Conformance is a legal determination made by the agency and contracting officer based on the evaluation report. The WCAG-EM methodology (W3C) and ICT Testing Baseline (GSA/ACOP) are recognized standards, not certifications. Procurement should be informed that the evaluation follows established federal evaluation methodology, but final conformance authority rests with the contracting officer and 508 coordinator.

### 5. PDFs & Intranet in Automated Pass
**No.** PDFs and Office documents are outside the web measurement stack. They map to the Electronic Documents baseline (57 tests) and require manual/AT methods. The intranet follows the same boundary rule; it cannot be included in the automated pass without explicit legal confirmation from the contracting officer that it falls under Revised Section 508 scope. Both will be handled via manual evaluation or excluded per scope gate.

---

## Testing Strategy (Audit-Scope Adapted)

### Evaluation Matrix & Methods
| Component | Method | Tool/Technique | Who Runs It |
|-----------|--------|----------------|-------------|
| Public Website (120 pages) | Automated scan + structured sample evaluation | axe-core, playwright-spec zoom/reflow, kat keyboard journeys | QA (automated), Evaluator (manual AT) |
| Grant Portal (25 screens) | Complete process testing + state coverage | kat driven sessions, vsr announcements, manual NVDA/JAWS/VoiceOver | Evaluator + 2 screen reader testers |
| Video Library (40 videos) | Media player control verification + caption/AD adequacy | agent-browser inventory, manual playback testing, listening session | Evaluator + human listener |
| PDFs (200 files) | Document structure & equivalence | Manual/AT method (Electronic Documents baseline) | Evaluator + document specialist |
| Intranet | Scope gate decision → sampling if included | Same as public site if legally required | Contracting officer decides; evaluator executes |

### Test Cases (Representative)
- **Keyboard Navigation:** Tab through all portal forms; verify logical order matches visual reading order; focus trap on timeout modal; Escape closes menus.
- **Screen Reader Compatibility:** NVDA/JAWS/VoiceOver announce landmarks, headings, form labels, error messages via `aria-describedby`; video player controls announced correctly.
- **State Communication:** Form validation errors use `aria-invalid="true"` + associated message; loading states use `aria-busy="true"` or `role="status"`; timeout warning announces remaining time.
- **Contrast & Resize:** All text 4.5:1 (normal) or 3:1 (large); focus indicators have 3:1 contrast change; 200% zoom reflows without horizontal scroll.
- **Forms & Error Prevention:** Required fields marked with `aria-required` + visible label; error messages suggest fixes; timeout extends session per user control.

### Dynamic Test Prioritization
- High risk: Portal forms, timeout handling, video player controls → prioritize manual AT and complete process testing.
- Medium risk: Public site navigation, search filters → prioritize axe-core scan + structured sample.
- Low risk: Static pages, news archives → automated scan only.

---

## Timeline & Team Allocation (12 Weeks)

| Week | Phase | Deliverable |
|------|-------|-------------|
| 1-2 | Scope finalization, sampling design, baseline setup, intranet/PDF boundary confirmation | EM Step 1/2 artifacts, sample set documentation |
| 3-5 | Automated scanning (axe-core), structured sample evaluation, manual AT sessions (NVDA/JAWS/VoiceOver) | Scan logs, AT session traces, partial findings |
| 6-8 | Complete process testing (portal flows, timeout handling), video/media review, PDF document evaluation | Process test results, media adequacy report, PDF findings |
| 9-10 | Analysis, VPAT 2.4 drafting, remediation recommendation mapping (508 floor vs WCAG 2.2 delta) | Draft VPAT, finding consolidation, delta declaration |
| 11-12 | Report compilation, stakeholder review, final delivery | Final A11y Evaluation Report, evidence contract, attachments |

**Team:** Evaluator leads manual AT, process testing, report drafting. Part-time QA runs automated scans, captures screenshots/traces, manages sample inventory. External screen reader testers (contracted if needed) validate portal flows.

---

## Report Structure & Deliverables

### Written Report Contents
1. **Scope & Target Declaration:** Product enclosure, conformance target (Revised Sec 508 floor), baseline, additional requirements.
2. **Sample Set & Rationale:** Structured + random samples, complete processes, state coverage, selection method.
3. **Per-SC Outcomes:** Passed / Failed / cantTell / inapplicable / untested for each evaluated criterion, with at least one example per failed SC.
4. **Remediation Recommendations (WCAG 2.2 AA):** Explicit delta declaration; prioritized fixes mapped to user impact (CRITICAL/MAJOR/MINOR/ENHANCEMENT).
5. **Third-Party & Boundary Notes:** CAPTCHAs, embedded media, PDFs, intranet status per partial-conformance rules.
6. **Executive Summary:** Conformance statement, risk summary, next steps for contract renewal.

### Attachable Proof for Contracting Officer
- Signed A11y Evaluation Report (PDF)
- VPAT 2.4 draft with SC outcomes and recommendations
- Evidence Finding Contract (per finding linking to sample set + evaluation context)
- Automated scan logs & kat trace artifacts
- Manual AT session screenshots/traces
- Sample set documentation with selection rationale

---

## a11y-Critic Review Checkpoints

| Checkpoint | After Phase | Focus Areas |
|-----------|-------------|------------|
| 🔍 1 | Scope & Sampling | Verify EM Step 1 artifacts complete; floor declaration explicit; intranet/PDF boundaries clear; sampling covers all 5 parts + processes |
| 🔍 2 | Tooling & Coverage | Verify ICT crosswalk coverage statement accurate; not-covered tests assigned to manual/AT; dual posture (report vs recommend) correctly separated |
| 🔍 3 | Report
